describe: say what is in the data: how many rows, which columns, anything missing
guide: Run the analysis: it already prints the rows, the columns and any empty cells. Then say what it printed.
Never state a finding the code has not computed: write code that prints the result, run it, then quote what it printed.
report: I looked through $table with the analysis.
teach: Looking at what is in the data before analysing it is how you catch a missing value or a column you did not expect.
